info.name: School ERP API
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the multi-tenant K-12 School ERP.

- Set `baseUrl` (default: http://localhost:3000) and `tenantId` in the collection variables.
- Tenancy is **path-based**: the pre-request script automatically injects the tenant into every `/api/tenant/*` URL as `/api/tenant/{tenantId}/…`.
- Every write request has a sensible example body; edit values before sending.

exec: // Auto-inject the tenant id into /api/tenant/* URLs so requests hit
// /api/tenant/{tenantId}/… without every URL having to hard-code it.
// Skip if the tenant is already the next segment.
